children.text: 在 shell 脚本执行期间，重定向到某个特定描述符

content.code:
#/bin/zsh

exec 1> stdo
exec 2> stde

echo "This is error." >&2
echo "This is normal output."

xt in ~/shell/redir λ cat stdo
This is normal output.
xt in ~/shell/redir λ cat stde
This is error.
